pages.text: Park within 6 blocks of a $(item)Repair Bench$() and right-click it. It shows the car part by part. $(l)Fit$() puts in parts you carry, free; the $(l)price$() button has the bench fit parts from its own stock, paid to its owner by card or cash.

An oil change takes a $(item)Motor Oil$(), brakes a set of $(item)Brake Pads$(). $(item)Engine Parts$() put back a quarter of the engine, $(item)Body Panel$()s a fifth of the body, and tires take a full set of $(item)Tire$()s. Diesel trucks and trailers take two of each.
The bench's owner gets $(l)Stock$() and $(l)Prices$() tabs, to run it as a mechanic's shop: hoppers and pipes can fill its stock. Fitting parts to someone else's car pays the $(thing)Mechanic$() job.
